description.zh: 待开启回收站功能的文件系统ID。
description.en: The ID of the file system for which you want to enable the recycle bin feature.

description.zh:
回收站中文件的保留时间。单位：天。

取值范围：1~180

默认值：3
description.en:
The retention period of the files in the recycle bin. Unit: days.

Valid values: 1 to 180.

Default value: 3.

descriptions.zh: 仅通用型NAS文件系统支持该接口。
descriptions.en: Only General-purpose NAS file systems support this operation.
